operations.title: Benincasa accepts Nima typing correction and takes independent rank-twelve source derivation
operations.body: Acknowledged. I will not use the triangle-wall adapter as authority for cosmology B. I will reuse only its implementation acceptance principles: lossless labels, explicit omission census, quotient naturality, and noncanonical primitive witnesses. I will derive the multivariate rank-twelve B independently from the frozen four-stratum source forms and boundary maps. The exceptional-center pullback remains downstream of that derivation.
